Default parameters for GPU fast clustering

params_sc_fast_cluster_gpu.Rd

GPU counterpart to bixverse::params_sc_fast_cluster(). Fast clustering coarsens the cells with k-means, builds a graph over the centroids and runs Louvain or Leiden on it. The community of each centroid is handed back to its cells. Only the k-means (and the cell-mediated top-m search) run on the GPU. The mini-batch k-means knobs are gone: the GPU k-means is full-batch Lloyd's.

Usage

params_sc_fast_cluster_gpu(
  n_centroids = NULL,
  k_means_iter = 50L,
  k_means_init = NULL,
  fixed = TRUE,
  quantise = FALSE,
  dist = c("euclidean", "cosine"),
  cell_mediated = FALSE,
  n_anchors = 5L,
  centroid_k = 15L,
  centroid_graph = list(),
  algorithm = c("louvain", "leiden"),
  n_iterations = NULL,
  beta = 0.01,
  min_gain = 0,
  local_moving = c("queue", "coloured"),
  multi_level = TRUE,
  max_evals = 10L
)

Arguments

n_centroids

Integer or NULL. Number of k-means centroids. If NULL, defaults to floor(sqrt(n_cells)). Defaults to NULL.

k_means_iter

Integer. Maximum number of k-means iterations. Defaults to 50L.

k_means_init

String or NULL. Initialisation method. One of "random", "parallel" or "plusplus". If NULL, picked on the Rust side based on the number of centroids. Defaults to NULL.

fixed

Boolean. Shall k-means run for a fixed number of iterations, without checking for convergence. wgpu only; MLX always runs every iteration. Defaults to TRUE.

quantise

Boolean. Shall the data buffer be held at fp16 on the GPU. Halves the buffer and helps when the assignment kernels are memory bound. wgpu only. Defaults to FALSE.

dist

String. Distance for the k-means and the centroid graph. One of c("euclidean", "cosine"). Defaults to "euclidean".

cell_mediated

Boolean. Shall the cell-mediated centroid graph from Secuer be built instead of the kNN graph on the centroids. Centroids are then linked by the cells that sit near both, so two centroids that are close in space but have no cells between them stay apart. If TRUE, centroid_k and centroid_graph are ignored. Defaults to FALSE.

n_anchors

Integer. Number of nearest centroids each cell links to in the cell-mediated graph. Only used if cell_mediated = TRUE. Defaults to 5L.

centroid_k

Integer. Neighbours per centroid in the exact centroid kNN. Only used if cell_mediated = FALSE. Defaults to 15L.

centroid_graph

List. Optional overrides for how the centroid kNN is turned into a graph. See bixverse::params_knn_graph_defaults(). Only used if cell_mediated = FALSE. Defaults to list().

algorithm

String. Community detection on the centroid graph. One of c("louvain", "leiden"). Defaults to "louvain".

n_iterations

Integer or NULL. Number of iterations of the community detection. A negative value iterates until stable. If NULL, the bixverse default for the chosen algorithm. Defaults to NULL.

beta

Numeric. Leiden only. Randomness of the refinement step. Defaults to 0.01.

min_gain

Numeric. With a negative n_iterations, also stop once an iteration gains no more than this in modularity. Defaults to 0.0.

local_moving

String. "queue" is Traag's sequential queue. "coloured" moves the nodes of one colour class in parallel, which only kicks in on larger levels of the graph. One of c("queue", "coloured"). Defaults to "queue".

multi_level

Boolean. Shall the communities be aggregated and refined in levels. Defaults to TRUE.

max_evals

Integer. Cap on the node evaluations per local moving phase, in units of the number of nodes. Defaults to 10L.

Value

A named list with the following elements:

  • n_centroids - Integer or NULL. Number of k-means centroids. If NULL, defaults to floor(sqrt(n_cells)). Defaults to NULL.

  • k_means_iter - Integer. Maximum number of k-means iterations. Defaults to 50L.

  • k_means_init - String or NULL. Initialisation method. One of "random", "parallel" or "plusplus". If NULL, picked on the Rust side based on the number of centroids. Defaults to NULL.

  • fixed - Boolean. Shall k-means run for a fixed number of iterations, without checking for convergence. wgpu only; MLX always runs every iteration. Defaults to TRUE.

  • quantise - Boolean. Shall the data buffer be held at fp16 on the GPU. Halves the buffer and helps when the assignment kernels are memory bound. wgpu only. Defaults to FALSE.

  • dist - String. Distance for the k-means and the centroid graph. One of c("euclidean", "cosine"). Defaults to "euclidean".

  • cell_mediated - Boolean. Shall the cell-mediated centroid graph from Secuer be built instead of the kNN graph on the centroids. Centroids are then linked by the cells that sit near both, so two centroids that are close in space but have no cells between them stay apart. If TRUE, centroid_k and centroid_graph are ignored. Defaults to FALSE.

  • n_anchors - Integer. Number of nearest centroids each cell links to in the cell-mediated graph. Only used if cell_mediated = TRUE. Defaults to 5L.

  • centroid_k - Integer. Neighbours per centroid in the exact centroid kNN. Only used if cell_mediated = FALSE. Defaults to 15L.

  • The elements of the base list, overridden by centroid_graph, spliced in at this position.

  • algorithm - String. Community detection on the centroid graph. One of c("louvain", "leiden"). Defaults to "louvain".

  • n_iterations - Integer or NULL. Number of iterations of the community detection. A negative value iterates until stable. If NULL, the bixverse default for the chosen algorithm. Defaults to NULL.

  • beta - Numeric. Leiden only. Randomness of the refinement step. Defaults to 0.01.

  • min_gain - Numeric. With a negative n_iterations, also stop once an iteration gains no more than this in modularity. Defaults to 0.0.

  • local_moving - String. "queue" is Traag's sequential queue. "coloured" moves the nodes of one colour class in parallel, which only kicks in on larger levels of the graph. One of c("queue", "coloured"). Defaults to "queue".

  • multi_level - Boolean. Shall the communities be aggregated and refined in levels. Defaults to TRUE.

  • max_evals - Integer. Cap on the node evaluations per local moving phase, in units of the number of nodes. Defaults to 10L.
